project_client_type_check.name: project_client_type_check
project_client_type_check.value: (("project"."type" = 'client' and "project"."client_id" is not null) or ("project"."type" = 'internal' and "project"."client_id" is null))

project_membership_role_check.name: project_membership_role_check
project_membership_role_check.value: "role" in ('Admin', 'Project Owner', 'Architect / Tech Lead', 'Business Analyst / Coordinator', 'Developer', 'QA', 'Client Viewer / Approver')

source_document_document_format_presence.name: source_document_document_format_presence_check
source_document_document_format_presence.value: (("source_document"."source_type" = 'document' and "source_document"."document_format" is not null) or ("source_document"."source_type" <> 'document' and "source_document"."document_format" is null))
